|errata_history={{Card errata/Run'heb Voend}}
This is version PC-E1 (2 of 2), 11 October 2026. This is the current text. The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' ([[Run'heb Voend]]): PC card image of 9 October 2026<ref name="ht-rv-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/1f401ba5a2c0ecb415b43001cefdb9a2f226553b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Dark/large/runhebvoend.gif runhebvoend.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/1f401ba5a2c0ecb415b43001cefdb9a2f226553b 1f401ba] (9 October 2026).</ref>, no errata mark.  Text: “Once per game, may ▼ a sandcrawler here. While driving a sandcrawler, it moves for free, may not be targeted by weapons, and Voend adds one battle destiny. Once during your turn, may choose a player to activate 1 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image of 11 October 2026<ref name="ht-rv-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/5aa6ad84446965cd2c9e9567016b93a7bba5876c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Dark/large/runhebvoend.gif runhebvoend.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/5aa6ad84446965cd2c9e9567016b93a7bba5876c 5aa6ad8] (11 October 2026).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: “Voend adds one battle destiny” becomes “Run'heb adds one battle destiny”. Text: “Once per game, may ▼ a sandcrawler here. While driving a sandcrawler, it moves for free, may not be targeted by weapons, and Run'heb adds one battle destiny. Once during your turn, may choose a player to activate 1 Force.”
What changed on the card image (crops of the two repository images):
